_note: Episode 36 (S4E5), story version 2, Kabanata 36 "Ang Paglayo". Manila, Hong Kong (Sheung Wan, Wan Chai, Central, Victoria Harbour) and Kawit, present day; the witness scene is Hong Kong, May 1898, the first flag sewn at 535 Morrison Hill Road, seen through a window from across the street (the three women are drawn small, gentle and not as portraits). Usman stays in Kawit. Indio strings as in Episode 34. Sinag takes the shape of an older, wearier Indio (no red handkerchief). The holding company in Central and its director are invented; every screen, register and letter carries only scribbles. Shots follow sentences.json; sentence 29 reuses fox_cu, sentence 16 reuses flag_sepia (the drawn Kawit window gave a wrong flag); k90 is a montage extra.
